You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 10fdf838e5f540beca466e9d1325999c072e5d3f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Christophe Leroy <christophe.leroy@c-s.fr>
Date: Mon, 10 Dec 2018 08:08:28 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] lib: fix build failure in CONFIG_DEBUG_VIRTUAL test

On several arches, virt_to_phys() is in io.h

Build fails without it:

  CC      lib/test_debug_virtual.o
lib/test_debug_virtual.c: In function 'test_debug_virtual_init':
lib/test_debug_virtual.c:26:7: error: implicit declaration of function 'virt_to_phys' [-Werror=implicit-function-declaration]
  pa = virt_to_phys(va);
       ^

Fixes: e4dace361552 ("lib: add test module for CONFIG_DEBUG_VIRTUAL")
CC: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Christophe Leroy <christophe.leroy@c-s.fr>
Reviewed-by: Kees Cook <keescook@chromium.org>
Signed-off-by: Michael Ellerman <mpe@ellerman.id.au>
---
 lib/test_debug_virtual.c | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/lib/test_debug_virtual.c b/lib/test_debug_virtual.c
index d5a06addeb27..bf864c73e462 100644
--- a/lib/test_debug_virtual.c
+++ b/lib/test_debug_virtual.c
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
 #include <linux/vmalloc.h>
 #include <linux/slab.h>
 #include <linux/sizes.h>
+#include <linux/io.h>
 
 #include <asm/page.h>
 #ifdef CONFIG_MIPS
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the absence of the necessary header file inclusion for the `virt_to_phys()` function, which resides in `io.h`. This led to an implicit declaration of the function in `test_debug_virtual.c`, resulting in a build failure when `CONFIG_DEBUG_VIRTUAL` was enabled. The fix involved including the missing `#include <linux/io.h>` directive to ensure proper declaration and usage of the `virt_to_phys()` function.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>

    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the absence of the necessary header file inclusion for the `virt_to_phys()` function, which resides in `io.h`. This led to an implicit declaration of the function in `test_debug_virtual.c`, resulting in a build failure when `CONFIG_DEBUG_VIRTUAL` was enabled. The fix involved including the missing `#include <linux/io.h>` directive to ensure proper declaration and usage of the `virt_to_phys()` function.
